name: mega65-dev
description: Systems-level MEGA65 development: the 45GS02 memory model, the MAP register and banking, 28-bit addressing and DMAgic, MEGA65/C65 hardware registers, the KERNAL jump table and its zero-page and Z-register hazards, the Hyppo hypervisor traps, and emulator-based testing under xemu. Toolchain-neutral, with claims checked against mega65-core, the MEGA65 Book, and the ROM sources.
